**Building the future of live entertainment** — you're not watching, you're
in it. Living worlds an audience helps shape, piloted into any place: a
venue, a live stream, a home.

Infinite Spaces is a marketplace for living worlds. Creators author participatory experiences in Playbox — worlds an audience helps shape — and run them live in venues, streams, and homes. A two-person crew produces what used to take a full production team.

The surface between a creator and a live experience. How you build authoring tools that feel like instruments, not dashboards. How creative direction gets encoded into a system. The gap between what a production designer imagines and what a technical system can produce — and how to close it.

## What You'll Do

What you'll ship in your first 90 days: Canvas and Pulse — the pre-show shared wall and in-show mobile control surface, deployed and stable at 5,000+ concurrent users.

## What We're Looking For

- Creative systems design — has built tooling for creative professionals; knows the difference between a tool that empowers and one that constrains
- Live events / production literacy — understands the workflow a show actually runs on: run-of-show, cues, operator handoffs, show control
- Frontend and interaction depth — can build interfaces that respond to real-time state and are operable in adverse conditions (dark room, poor wifi, under pressure)
- Systems generalist — comfortable reading and contributing to backend and rendering code; not purely a UI engineer
- Thinks in the authoring-to-experience arc: from how a creator shapes content to how an audience receives and participates in it

Adjacent experience that signals: TouchDesigner, Max/MSP or similar patching environments, experience building tools for live performance or installation art, WebXR, creative coding communities (Processing, p5.js, openFrameworks)

## Benefits

- Competitive Seattle salary and meaningful early equity
- Equity-heavy structures available before cash is fully in place, with an honest timeline to when salary normalizes
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- A small team where everyone owns real surface area and your work ships

*You're not watching. You're in it.*
